summary: Frontend-only test pass of the xoFit 4-page refactor (hub + Core/Mobile/VTO), nested navbar submenus (desktop + mobile), image loading, console errors, and regression of the other main nav routes. All routing, links, breadcrumbs, back links, content sections and images work. Two non-blocking issues found: (1) on mobile, the fixed cookie-consent banner intercepts pointer events over the lower part of the open mobile menu, blocking taps on nav items (reproduced: mobile-nav-sub-vto click timed out with cookie banner present, succeeded after Accept All); (2) none of the 4 xoFit pages (or other pages checked) render an <h1> element - hero titles use non-h1 markup (SEO/a11y). Also observed an intermittent 3rd-party TINT console error (api.tintvto.com /resolve 'Failed to fetch'), though the VTO widget did open and render frame thumbnails successfully in a separate run - no page crash.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844 with the cookie banner still shown (first-time visitor), the fixed cookie banner (z-[70], role=dialog) intercepts pointer events over the open mobile menu, so lower nav links (e.g. xoFit > VTO) cannot be tapped. Playwright click timed out for 30s; after clicking 'Accept all' the same link clicked and navigated fine.
No <h1> on any of the 4 xoFit pages (document.querySelectorAll('h1').length === 0); only h2s present. SEO/accessibility gap for new dedicated sub-pages.

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent 3rd-party console error 'TINT Error: Fetch request to https://api.tintvto.com/api/v1/public/resolve TypeError: Failed to fetch'. In a separate run the widget modal opened and rendered frame catalog correctly and no vto-error-message was displayed. No crash, but there is no graceful UI message when the resolve call fails.

action_items: Prevent the cookie consent banner from blocking taps on the open mobile menu (e.g. hide/lower z-index of the banner while the mobile menu is open, or raise mobile menu above z-[70]).
Add an <h1> to each xoFit page hero (hub, Core, Mobile, VTO) for SEO/a11y.
Consider surfacing vto-error-message when the Tint resolve fetch fails so users see a graceful error instead of an endless spinner.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar desktop submenu relies solely on hover (onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave) with no keyboard/focus or click toggle - the parent button has no aria-expanded/aria-haspopup and submenu is unreachable via keyboard.
FitVto.jsx has no breadcrumb-xofit link at the top (Core and Mobile both do) - inconsistent navigation affordance across the 3 sub-pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: /xofit-frame-fitting hub loads with hero, 'when the fit is wrong' section and 'Three Form Factors' grid; all 3 form-factor-link-* links navigate correctly; /xofit-core and /xofit-mobile have breadcrumb-xofit, hero CTA, tiles (core-tile-0/mobile-tile-0), Delivers/Works/Features sections and working back links; /xofit-vto has vto-trigger-button (opens Tint modal with frames), vto-back-link works. 0 broken images on all 4 pages (4/7/7/5 images each) and 0 failed network requests. Desktop nav dropdown shows nav-child-overview/xoiris/xoexam/xofit/xolab plus nav-subchild-core/mobile/vto - all click through correctly (nav-child-xofit passed on 3/3 retries; one earlier failure was transient). Mobile menu (mobile-menu-toggle) expands xoFit with mobile-nav-sub-core/mobile/vto, navigates and closes. Regression: /, /xo-vision-care-system, /xoiris-scheduling, /xoexam-eye-exam, /xolab-eyewear-finishing all render with no broken images/console errors.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile nav click blockage: CookieConsent renders a fixed bottom dialog with z-[70] while the mobile menu panel lives inside the header (z-50), so the banner sits above menu items in the lower viewport and swallows pointer events.
